visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is positioned in the center of the frame, silhouetted against a large floor-to-ceiling window that overlooks a panoramic urban landscape during sunset. She holds a silver transverse flute and plays an intricate, fast-paced melody. Her body sways rhythmically, with her hips and torso moving in coordination with the music's tempo. She is dressed in a light pink sleeveless crop top and a tan outfit consisting of a short skirt over matching wide-leg trousers. Her facial expression remains concentrated on the performance. A digital musical staff with scrolling notes is overlaid at the top of the frame, while various instructional text captions appear at the bottom. The lighting is primarily natural and warm, originating from the sun behind her, casting the interior in soft shadows while highlighting the vibrant orange sky.
